description: This file contains integration tests for the DELETE endpoint of catalog items API, specifically testing the deletion of catalog items with valid and invalid IDs using an admin user token.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Contains integration tests for the DELETE catalog item API endpoint.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a catalog item with a valid ID returns a success response.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting a catalog item with an invalid ID returns a not found response.
